texts: good. parses as a rule that fires for any villager who is not a Keeper, with the avoiding, the Sunken Cove's name and the Cove's kind all recorded.
good. the villagers' opinion is recorded without asserting that the Cove Stair really is unlucky, and the opinion is carried down to each villager as well as to the group.
good. the denial of a prohibition lands as a plain permission fact about the Cove Stair, and nothing is invented to fill in what the Stair is not forbidden for.

good. the relative clause 'who play near the Cove Stair' becomes the rule's condition, so the rule fires for any parent and any child playing there; the proximity is recorded as the location of the playing event.
